items.name: Truffle Arancini
items.description: Golden, crispy risotto spheres with molten taleggio centers, finished with shaved black truffle and warm parmesan cream.

items.name: Spicy Korean Chicken Wings
items.description: Double-fried wings glazed in fiery gochujang honey, scattered with toasted sesame and fresh scallion.

items.name: Burrata Bruschetta
items.description: Creamy hand-pulled burrata over charred sourdough with heirloom tomatoes, basil oil, and aged balsamic.

items.name: Crispy Calamari
items.description: Lightly battered calamari fried until shatter-crisp, served with smoked paprika aioli and a squeeze of lemon.

items.name: Soup of the Day
items.description: Chef's daily creation, simmered slowly from seasonal vegetables and finished with herb oil and crusty bread.

items.name: Wild Mushroom Risotto
items.description: Slow-stirred carnaroli rice with porcini, chanterelles, and shiitake, finished with mascarpone and thyme.

items.name: Cedar-Grilled Salmon
items.description: Faroe Island salmon grilled over cedar, glazed with miso-maple, served on charred bok choy and jasmine rice.

items.name: Wagyu Beef Burger
items.description: Eight ounces of American wagyu on a toasted brioche bun with aged cheddar, caramelized onion jam, and truffle fries.

items.name: Margherita Pizza
items.description: Wood-fired Neapolitan crust with San Marzano tomato, hand-torn fior di latte, and a flourish of basil and olive oil.

items.name: Chicken Shawarma Wrap
items.description: Spit-roasted chicken with garlic toum, pickled turnip, and crispy shoestring fries wrapped in warm saj bread.

items.name: Pasta Carbonara
items.description: Hand-rolled tonnarelli tossed with guanciale, pecorino romano, and silky egg yolk, cracked with black pepper.

items.name: Vegan Buddha Bowl
items.description: Turmeric quinoa, roasted sweet potato, charred broccolini, avocado, and crispy chickpeas with tahini-lemon dressing.

items.name: Sparkling Water (Small)
items.description: Crisp Italian mineral water with fine, lively bubbles served chilled with citrus.

items.name: Sparkling Water (Large)
items.description: A 750ml bottle of crisp Italian mineral water, perfect for sharing across the table.

items.name: Fresh-Pressed Lemonade
items.description: Hand-squeezed Meyer lemons with cane sugar and a whisper of muddled mint, served over crushed ice.

items.name: Iced Matcha Latte
items.description: Stone-ground ceremonial-grade matcha whisked with cold oat milk and a touch of vanilla, poured over ice.

items.name: House Red Wine
items.description: A medium-bodied Tuscan sangiovese with notes of cherry, leather, and dried herbs, by the glass.

items.name: Classic Tiramisu
items.description: Espresso-soaked savoiardi layered with airy mascarpone cream and a generous dusting of bitter cocoa.

items.name: Warm Chocolate Fondant
items.description: Dark Valrhona chocolate cake with a molten center, paired with salted caramel gelato and toasted hazelnuts.

items.name: Artisan Gelato
items.description: Three scoops of house-churned gelato — pistachio, stracciatella, and Madagascar vanilla — with candied almonds.

items.name: New York Cheesecake
items.description: Velvety vanilla bean cheesecake on a buttery graham crust, topped with macerated summer berries.
